_doc: Hover simulator model of the Packet V0 drone (X650, 6S). SI units, body FRD, world NED. Identified values: tools/sim/hover/IDENT.md (logs 18-45, Pi recordings 2026-11-02/03).
_inertia_doc: set so that torque per unit ATC output (0.4596 * thrust_full = 11.89 N m) / I = identified K: roll 77, pitch 73, yaw ~8 rad/s^2
_thrust_doc: per-motor thrust at full actuator and full voltage: m g / 4 / MOT_THST_HOVER(out of ground effect, 0.2769). ArduPilot's voltage compensation cancels battery_v.
_motor_doc: identified 52 ms total; split (log 45 fit): lag 10-30 ms + pure delay 23-35 ms
_ge_doc: fit: k(h) = 1 + a exp(-h/b), h = height above the resting height (logs: a 0.038 +-0.004, b 2.8 +-0.6 cm)
_imu_doc: identified: IMU 4.9-6.3 cm above the CG (x, y not identifiable); INS_POS* = 0 on the drone
_dist_doc: angular (rad/s^2) and linear (m/s^2) disturbance as sums of OU processes. Angular: logged residual band RMS (roll 0.3-1 Hz 0.23, 1-3 Hz 0.24, 3-6 Hz 0.31-0.36 rad/s^2). Linear: raised from the residual (0.006-0.014) to 0.025 (xy) and 0.06 (z) at tau 1 s so that the hold position error matches log 43 (compare.py, hold window)

camera._lat_doc: exposure->t_cap 60 ms (+-15): fitted from the 4 Hz attitude-match error in logs 41-45 (scratchpad latfit3.py; the method reads 10-20 ms low on sim logs with known L, corrected); t_cap->detection 52 ms (49-56); t_cap->FC 57 ms (55-66), jitter 4-5 ms. Total exposure->FC ~117 ms; the FC (VISO_DELAY_MS 60) assumes 71.5 ms
camera._noise_doc: static 0.2-0.4 mm; hover frame jitter median 1.3 mm, p90 3.5-5 mm (includes real motion). Sim 1.0 mm xy with 10 % of frames x4: the VISION_SPEED spread then matches log 43 (sim 19-20 mm/s, real 23-25)
camera._cam_pos_doc: lens relative to the CG (CAD mount A). The Pi assumes --mount-fwd 0.134 --mount-down 0.02: it reports a point 8.1 cm below the CG (pi_cam_pos_err = Pi lens offset - true lens offset)

_geom_doc: CAD (Packet V0/05_viewer): motors (+-0.2299, +-0.2299), prop plane 8 cm above the CG, skids 0.30 m below the CG, track +-0.159, length +-0.163
_thrust_axis_doc: thrust direction off the IMU -z axis as a fraction of thrust (body x, y). Logs 43/45: the drone holds +0.8-0.9 deg pitch, PSC I term -0.15 m/s^2 N and -0.04 m/s^2 E at yaw ~350 deg
